detail.longDescription: There are too many messaging apps. Meta alone has three: Messenger, WhatsApp, and Instagram. Throw in regular texting like SMS and iMessage, secure apps like Signal, work apps like Slack, and even offbeat options like Discord and X, and the situation just gets silly. But what if you just had one app where you could message your friends, family, work colleagues, and everyone else?
